c.t: Amchur is tart dried-mango powder, sold in Indian groceries, spice shops and online. Substitute 1 tsp (4 g) citric acid, or 2 tsp (10 ml) tamarind paste or lime juice (add those with the moist ingredients in step 3). Soak bamboo skewers in water for at least 2 hours so they do not burn.

Amčúr je kyslý prášok zo sušeného manga; dostanete ho v indických obchodoch, obchodoch s korením a online. Nahradiť ho môžete 1 ČL (4 g) kyseliny citrónovej alebo 2 ČL (10 ml) tamarindovej pasty či limetkovej šťavy (tie pridajte s vlhkými surovinami v kroku 3). Bambusové špízy namočte aspoň na 2 hodiny do vody, aby nezhoreli.

en.t: 2 tsp (6 g) whole black peppercorns
1 1/2 tsp (4 g) whole coriander seed
1 tsp (4 g) whole cumin seed
2 whole cloves (1 g)
2 whole bay leaves
2 tsp (8 g) sweet paprika
1/2 tsp (2 g) cayenne pepper
3 tsp (12 g) kosher salt (if using table salt, use 1 1/2 tsp by volume, or 12 g by weight)
1 tsp (4 g) amchur powder
1 medium red onion, roughly chopped (about 170 g)
55 g loosely packed fresh cilantro leaves
4 medium cloves garlic, roughly chopped (about 20 g)
1 1/2 tbsp (22 ml) grated fresh ginger, roughly chopped (about 20 g)
1 to 4 green Thai bird chilies, stems removed (to taste; they are very spicy)
1 1/2 tsp (6 g) sugar (about 7 g)
1000 g ground lamb or beef (about 20% fat content)
Shredded cabbage or 1 recipe Spicy Cabbage and Red Onion Slaw
Sliced cucumbers, tomatoes (cut into bite-size pieces), and lime wedges

1. Toast peppercorns, coriander, cumin, and cloves in a dry skillet over medium heat, tossing and shaking frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Transfer to a spice grinder. Add bay leaves and grind to a fine powder. Transfer to the bowl of a food processor.

2. Add paprika, cayenne, salt, amchur, red onion, cilantro, garlic, ginger, chiles, and sugar to bowl of food processor and process until a fine paste has formed, about 30 seconds. Transfer mixture to a double layer of heavy-duty paper towels or a triple layer of cheesecloth. Fold towels over mixture and press gently to start extracting liquid. Lift up towels and form a bundle. Squeeze gently over sink to remove excess liquid. The remaining mixture should be dry enough to crumble when picked up.

3. Combine ground beef or lamb with the spice/aromatic blend and massage with your hands until completely homogeneous and slightly tacky, about 4 minutes. Continue as directed, or, for better texture, let mixture rest, covered, in the refrigerator for several hours or up to 1 day.

4. Divide mixture into 12 even portions of about 85 g each. Roll into cylinders about 15 cm long and 2 cm wide and thread onto metal or bamboo skewers which have been pre-soaked in water for at least 2 hours to prevent burning.

5. Light one chimney full of charcoal. When all charcoal is lit and covered with gray ash, pour out and arrange coals on one side of charcoal grate. Set cooking grate in place, cover grill, and allow to preheat for 5 minutes. Alternatively, set half the burners on a gas grill to the highest heat setting, cover, and preheat for 10 minutes. Clean and oil grilling grate. Working in batches if necessary, place skewers over cooler side of grill, cover, and cook until they are nearly cooked through, about 5 minutes. (If you prefer, you can continue to let them cook through completely on cooler side, for more traditional, color-free results.) Open grill and transfer skewers to hot side. Continue to cook, turning frequently, until well browned on all sides, a few minutes longer.
6. Transfer to a serving platter and serve immediately with shredded cabbage or spicy cabbage and red onion slaw, cucumber, tomatoes, and lime wedges.

1. Zrnká korenia, koriander, rímsku rascu a klinčeky opražíme na suchej panvici na strednom ohni, často premiešavame a potrasieme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 1 minútu. Preložíme do mlynčeka na korenie. Pridáme bobkové listy a pomelieme na jemný prášok. Preložíme do nádoby kuchynského robota.

2. Do nádoby kuchynského robota pridáme papriku, kajenské korenie, soľ, amchur, červenú cibuľu, koriandrovú vňať, cesnak, zázvor, čili papričky a cukor a mixujeme, kým nevznikne jemná pasta, asi 30 sekúnd. Zmes preložíme na dvojitú vrstvu pevných papierových utierok alebo trojitú vrstvu gázy. Utierky preložíme cez zmes a jemne pritlačíme, aby začala púšťať tekutinu. Utierky zdvihneme a vytvoríme uzlík. Nad drezom ho jemne vytlačíme, aby sme odstránili prebytočnú tekutinu. Zvyšná zmes má byť dosť suchá, aby sa po zdvihnutí drobila.

3. Mleté hovädzie alebo jahňacie mäso spojíme so zmesou korenia a aromatických prísad a rukami miesime, kým nie je úplne jednoliate a mierne lepkavé, asi 4 minúty. Pokračujeme podľa postupu, alebo pre lepšiu štruktúru necháme zmes prikrytú odpočívať v chladničke niekoľko hodín alebo až 1 deň.

4. Zmes rozdelíme na 12 rovnakých dielov asi po 85 g. Vyvaľkáme z nich valčeky dlhé asi 15 cm a hrubé 2 cm a napichneme ich na kovové alebo bambusové ražniči, ktoré sme aspoň 2 hodiny namáčali vo vode, aby sa nepripálili.

5. Zapálime plný komínový podpaľovač dreveného uhlia. Keď je všetko uhlie rozpálené a pokryté sivým popolom, vysypeme ho a rozložíme na jednu stranu uhoľného roštu. Vložíme grilovací rošt, gril prikryjeme a necháme 5 minút predhriať. Prípadne na plynovom grile nastavíme polovicu horákov na najvyšší stupeň, prikryjeme a predhrievame 10 minút. Grilovací rošt očistíme a naolejujeme. Ak treba, po dávkach kladieme ražniči nad chladnejšiu stranu grilu, prikryjeme a grilujeme, kým nie sú takmer prepečené, asi 5 minút. (Ak chceme, môžeme ich nechať úplne dopiecť na chladnejšej strane; výsledok bude tradičnejší, bez opečenej farby.) Gril otvoríme a ražniči presunieme na horúcu stranu. Grilujeme ďalej, často obraciame, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán dobre opečené, ešte niekoľko minút.
6. Preložíme na servírovací tanier a hneď podávame s nastrúhanou kapustou alebo pikantným šalátom z kapusty a červenej cibule, uhorkou, paradajkami a mesiačikmi limetky.

en.t: 59 ml vegetable oil

2 medium onions, chopped medium (about 475 ml)

4 to 5 tbsp (59–74 ml) Jamaican curry powder (spicy or non-spicy)
5 cm piece of ginger, peeled and minced (about 2 tbsp (30 ml) minced)
2 to 3 habanero or Scotch bonnet peppers, seeded and chopped
945 ml water or low-sodium chicken broth
Kosher salt
2 medium russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 2.5 cm cubes (about 475 ml)

1. For the Curry: Heat 2 tbsp (30 ml) of oil in a 2840 ml saucepan or dutch oven over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add 1/3 of goat to pan and brown on all sides, about 6 minutes. Transfer to a plate. Repeat with remaining goat in two more batches, adding additional oil as necessary and controlling heat to prevent burning.
2. Return pan to heat and add onions and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently until onions are softened, about 4 minutes. Add curry powder and cook, stirring constantly until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

3. Add ginger and pepper and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the water or chicken broth to the pot, along with the browned meat. Add 2 tsp (10 ml) kosher salt. Scrape up any browned bits from bottom of pot. Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, cover the pot, and cook for 1 1/2 hours. Add potatoes and continue cooking until goat is completely tender, 30 minutes to 1 hour longer.

4. For Serving: Skim the fat off the broth. Or, let the curry cool and place it into the refrigerator. Skim off the solidified fat on top. Warm the curry again. Season to taste with more salt, and serve.

c.t: 1. For the Curry: Heat 1¼ tbsp (18 ml) of oil in a 2840 ml saucepan or dutch oven over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add 1/3 of goat to pan and brown on all sides, about 6 minutes. 2. Return pan to heat and add onions and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently until onions are softened, about 4 minutes. Add curry powder and cook, stirring constantly until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

3. Add ginger and pepper and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the water or chicken broth to the pot, along with the browned meat. Add 2 tsp (10 ml) kosher salt. Scrape up any browned bits from bottom of pot. Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, cover the pot, and cook for 1 1/2 hours. Add potatoes and continue cooking until goat is completely tender, 30 minutes to 1 hour longer.

4. For Serving: Skim the fat off the broth. Or, let the curry cool and place it into the refrigerator. Skim off the solidified fat on top. Warm the curry again. Season to taste with more salt, and serve.

1. Kari: v hrnci s objemom 2840 ml alebo liatinovom hrnci zohrejeme na stredne silnom ohni 1¼ PL (18 ml) oleja, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. 1. For the Marinated Oxtail: In a blender, combine onion, scallion, garlic, and Scotch bonnet with 120 ml water and blend until thoroughly pureed. Rub oxtail all over with soy sauce, salt, pepper, and thyme. Transfer oxtail to a large bowl or large zipper-lock bag and pour blended aromatics on top. Mix well to coat, then cover bowl or seal bag, pushing out air as you go. Refrigerate for 24 hours.
2. Remove oxtail from marinade and scrape off excess marinade. Reserve marinade for later use.

3. For the Stew: In a Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Working in batches to avoid crowding the pot, add oxtail and cook until browned all over, about 5 minutes per side (oxtail will brown more quickly and deeply due to the marinade, but turn down heat if it threatens to burn). Transfer oxtail to a platter and repeat with remaining oxtail, adding more oil to the pot if necessary.
4. Add 240 ml water to Dutch oven and bring to a simmer, scraping bottom of pot to remove any browned bits. Return oxtail and any juices to the pot.

5. Add onions, scallion, garlic, thyme, Scotch bonnet pepper, and browning or soy sauce to oxtail. Add just enough water to cover meat, bring to a simmer, then reduce heat, cover, and let simmer for 40 minutes.

6. Add reserved oxtail marinade to pot and stir to combine. Continue to gently simmer, uncovered, adding a little water from time to time to ensure oxtail remains just barely covered, until oxtail is tender, about 2 hours.

7. For the Spinners (Optional) and to Finish: If making spinners: In a small bowl, whisk together flour and a large pinch of salt. Add 118 ml cold water and knead until a sticky dough ball forms. Cover and let rest 15 minutes. Tear off small pieces of dough and roll them into cigarette-sized strips. Stir into oxtail.
8. Stir in butter or broad beans and let simmer until stew is thickened, about 30 minutes. Remove thyme sprigs.
9. Add black pepper, season with salt, and serve with white rice or rice and peas, plantain, sliced avocado, and a nice fresh green salad.

1. Marinovaný oxtail: v mixéri spojíme cibuľu, jarnú cibuľku, cesnak a papričku Scotch bonnet so 120 ml vody a dôkladne rozmixujeme na pyré. Oxtail (hovädzí chvost) zo všetkých strán potrieme sójovou omáčkou, soľou, korením a tymiánom. Oxtail preložíme do veľkej misy alebo veľkého uzatvárateľného vrecka a zalejeme rozmixovanými aromatickými prísadami. Dobre premiešame, aby sa obalil, potom misu prikryjeme alebo vrecko uzavrieme a vytlačíme vzduch. Necháme 24 hodín v chladničke.
2. Oxtail vyberieme z marinády a zoškrabeme prebytočnú marinádu. Marinádu si odložíme na neskôr.

3. Ragú: v liatinovom hrnci zohrejeme na stredne silnom ohni olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Po dávkach, aby sme hrniec nepreplnili, vkladáme oxtail a opekáme, kým nie je zo všetkých strán opečený, asi 5 minút z každej strany (vďaka marináde hnedne rýchlejšie a tmavšie; ak hrozí pripálenie, stlmíme oheň). Oxtail preložíme na tanier a zopakujeme so zvyšným mäsom; ak treba, do hrnca prilejeme olej.
4. Do hrnca nalejeme 240 ml vody, privedieme k miernemu varu a zoškrabeme zo dna pripečené zvyšky. Oxtail aj so šťavou vrátime do hrnca.

5. K oxtailu pridáme cibuľu, jarnú cibuľku, cesnak, tymián, papričku Scotch bonnet a browning alebo sójovú omáčku. Prilejeme len toľko vody, aby bolo mäso ponorené, privedieme k miernemu varu, potom oheň stlmíme, prikryjeme a dusíme 40 minút.

6. Do hrnca pridáme odloženú marinádu z oxtailu a premiešame. Jemne dusíme ďalej bez pokrievky a z času na čas prilejeme trochu vody, aby bol oxtail len tak-tak ponorený, kým nie je mäkký, asi 2 hodiny.

7. Spinners (nepovinné) a dokončenie: ak robíme spinners, v malej miske metličkou zmiešame múku s veľkou štipkou soli. Prilejeme 118 ml studenej vody a miesime, kým nevznikne lepkavá guľa cesta. Prikryjeme a necháme 15 minút odpočívať. Odtrhávame malé kúsky cesta a vyvaľkáme z nich prúžky veľkosti cigarety. Vmiešame ich k oxtailu.
8. Vmiešame maslo alebo bôb a dusíme, kým ragú nezhustne, asi 30 minút. Vyberieme vetvičky tymiánu.
9. Pridáme čierne korenie, osolíme a podávame s bielou ryžou alebo ryžou s fazuľou (rice and peas), plantainom, plátkami avokáda a peknou čerstvou zelenou šalátovou misou.

en.t: 2040 g lamb shoulder chops (blade or round bone), each 2.5–4 cm thick, trimmed, meat removed from bones and cut into 4 cm pieces
3 tbsp (44 ml) vegetable oil
3 onions (about 1130 g), chopped coarse (about 1180 ml)
30 g unbleached all-purpose flour
710 ml water
1 tbsp (15 ml) minced fresh thyme or 1 tsp (5 ml) dried
905 g Yukon Gold potatoes (about 6 medium), peeled and cut into 2.5 cm cubes
59 ml minced fresh parsley leaves

1. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and heat oven to 150 °C (fan 130 °C). Cut meat from bones and reserve bones. Trim meat of excess fat and cut into 4 cm cubes. Season meat generously with salt and pepper.

2. Heat 1 tbsp (15 ml) oil in large ovenproof Dutch oven over medium-high heat until shimmering, about 2 minutes. Add half of meat to pot so that individual pieces are close together but not touching. Cook, without moving, until sides touching pot are well-browned, 2 to 3 minutes. Using tongs, turn each piece and continue cooking until most sides are well-browned, about 5 minutes longer. Transfer meat to medium bowl, add another 1 tbsp (15 ml) oil to pot, and swirl to coat pan bottom. Brown remaining lamb; transfer meat to bowl and set aside.

3. Reduce heat to medium, add remaining tbsp oil, and swirl to coat pan bottom. Add onions and 1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) salt and cook, stirring frequently and vigorously, scraping bottom of pot with wooden spoon to loosen browned bits, until onions have browned, about 8 minutes. Add flour and stir until onions are evenly coated, 1 to 2 minutes.

4. Stir in 355 ml of water, scraping pan bottom and edges with wooden spoon to loosen remaining browned bits. Gradually add remaining 355 ml water, stirring constantly and scraping pan edges to dissolve flour. Add thyme and 1 tsp (5 ml) salt and bring to simmer. Add bones and then meat and accumulated juices. Return to simmer, cover, and place in oven. Cook for 1 hour.

5. Remove pot from oven and place potatoes on top of meat and bones. Cover and return pot to oven and cook until meat is tender, about 1 hour. If serving immediately, stir potatoes into liquid, wait 5 minutes, and spoon off any fat that rises to top. (Stew can be covered and refrigerated for up to 3 days. Spoon off congealed fat and bring back to simmer over medium-low heat.)
6. Stir in parsley and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Remove bones if desired. Serve immediately.

2. Vo veľkom liatinovom hrnci vhodnom do rúry zohrejeme na stredne silnom ohni 1¾ ČL (9 ml) oleja, kým sa nezačne lesknúť, asi 2 minúty. Vložíme polovicu mäsa tak, aby boli kúsky blízko seba, ale nedotýkali sa. Bez hýbania opekáme, kým strany dotýkajúce sa hrnca nie sú dobre opečené, 2 až 3 minúty. Kliešťami obrátime každý kúsok a opekáme ďalej, kým nie je väčšina strán dobre opečená, ešte asi 5 minút. Mäso preložíme do strednej misy, do hrnca pridáme ďalšiu 1 PL (15 ml) oleja a zakrúžime, aby pokryl dno. Opečieme zvyšné jahňacie mäso; preložíme ho do misy a odložíme.

3. Oheň stlmíme na stredný, pridáme zvyšnú PL oleja a zakrúžime, aby pokryl dno. Pridáme cibuľu a 1/4 ČL (1,2 ml) soli a opekáme za častého a energického miešania, drevenou varechou zoškrabujeme dno hrnca, aby sa uvoľnili pripečené zvyšky, kým cibuľa nezhnedne, asi 8 minút. Pridáme múku a miešame, kým sa cibuľa rovnomerne neobalí, 1 až 2 minúty.

4. Vmiešame 355 ml vody a drevenou varechou zoškrabeme dno a okraje hrnca, aby sa uvoľnili zvyšné pripečené zvyšky. Postupne prilejeme zvyšných 355 ml vody za stáleho miešania a zoškrabovania okrajov, aby sa múka rozpustila. Pridáme tymián a 1 ČL (5 ml) soli a privedieme k miernemu varu. Pridáme kosti a potom mäso aj s nazbieranou šťavou. Znova privedieme k miernemu varu, prikryjeme a vložíme do rúry. Dusíme 1 hodinu.

5. Hrniec vyberieme z rúry a na mäso a kosti položíme zemiaky. Prikryjeme, vrátime do rúry a dusíme, kým mäso nie je mäkké, asi 1 hodinu. Ak podávame hneď, zemiaky vmiešame do šťavy, počkáme 5 minút a lyžicou zoberieme tuk, ktorý vystúpi na povrch. (Prikryté ragú vydrží v chladničke až 3 dni. Stuhnutý tuk zoberieme a na stredne miernom ohni znova privedieme k miernemu varu.)
6. Vmiešame petržlenovú vňať a dochutíme soľou a korením. Podľa chuti vyberieme kosti. Hneď podávame.

time.en: 10 min | Cook: 65 min | Total: not given

en.t: 3 whole sweet fresh dried chiles like Costeño, New Mexico, or Choricero, stems and seeds removed
2 small hot dried chiles like Arbol or Cascabel, stems and seeds removed
3 whole rich fruity dried chiles like Ancho, Mulatto, Negro, or Pasilla, stems and seeds removed
1420 ml homemade chicken stock or store-bought low-sodium broth
2 whole Chipotle dried chiles canned in adobo sauce, plus 2 tbsp (30 ml) sauce, stems and seeds removed
1810 g whole beef chuck, trimmed of excess gristle and fat, cut into 2 to 3 large steaks
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
2 tbsp (30 ml) vegetable oil
1 large onion, finely diced
4 medium cloves garlic, minced
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) powdered cinnamon
1 tbsp (15 ml) ground cumin
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) ground allspice
2 tsp (10 ml) dried oregano
2 tbsp (30 ml) Asian fish sauce, plus more to taste
2 to 3 tbsp (30–44 ml) masa harina (optional)
2 tbsp (30 ml) apple cider vinegar
Hot sauce, to taste
Cilantro, chopped onions, scallions, grated cheese, avocado, and warm tortillas for serving as desired

1. Add dried chiles to large heavy-bottomed Dutch oven or stock pot and cook over medium-high heat, stirring frequently, until slightly darkened with intense, roasted aroma, 2 to 5 minutes. Do not allow to smoke. Remove chiles to small bowl and set aside. Alternatively, place dried chiles on a microwave-safe plate and microwave on high power in 15-second increments until pliable and toasted-smelling, about 30 seconds total. Transfer to a 1890 ml microwave-safe liquid measuring cup or bowl. Add chicken broth and chipotle chiles, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave on high power until gently simmering, about 5 minutes. Remove from microwave and set aside.

2. Season chuck steaks generously with salt and pepper. Heat oil in the base of an electric or stovetop pressure cooker over high heat until just starting to smoke. Add half of beef chuck in a single layer and cook without moving until deeply browned, about 6 minutes. Flip steaks and brown second side, 3 to 4 minutes longer. Transfer steaks to a cutting board.

3. Add onions to pressure cooker and cook, stirring frequently until translucent and softened, about 2 minutes. Add garlic, cinnamon, cumin, allspice, and oregano, and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the soaked chiles and the chicken broth and bring to a simmer. Transfer mixture to the jar of a blender. Blend, starting on the lowest possible setting and gradually increasing speed to high (make sure to hold the lid down with a clean kitchen towel or a potholder to prevent it from blowing out). Blend until smooth, about 1 minute. Return purée to the pressure cooker.

4. Cut the seared and raw chuck steaks into 4–5 cm chunks and transfer to the pressure cooker. Bring to a simmer, season gently with salt and pepper, seal pressure cooker, and cook on high pressure for 30 minutes.

5. Release pressure using quick release valve on an electric cooker or running under cold water for a stovetop cooker. Remove lid. Stir in fish sauce, masa harina (if using), and vinegar. Add hot sauce to taste. Simmer until thickened to desired consistency, about 5 minutes. Season to taste with salt. For best results, allow chili to cool and store in the refrigerator at least overnight and up to five days. Reheat the next day to serve.
6. Serve, garnished with cilantro, chopped onions, scallions, grated cheese, avocado, and warm tortillas as desired.

1. Sušené čili papričky dáme do veľkého liatinového hrnca s hrubým dnom alebo hrnca na vývar a za častého miešania ich opekáme na stredne silnom ohni, kým mierne nestmavnú a nevoňajú intenzívne a pražene, 2 až 5 minút. Nenecháme ich dymiť. Papričky preložíme do malej misky a odložíme. Prípadne sušené papričky položíme na tanier vhodný do mikrovlnnej rúry a ohrievame na plný výkon po 15 sekundách, kým nie sú ohybné a nevoňajú pražene, spolu asi 30 sekúnd. Preložíme do 1,89-litrovej odmerky alebo misy vhodnej do mikrovlnnej rúry. Pridáme kurací vývar a papričky chipotle, prikryjeme fóliou a ohrievame na plný výkon, kým jemne nezačne vrieť, asi 5 minút. Vyberieme z mikrovlnnej rúry a odložíme.

2. Steaky z pliecka výdatne osolíme a okoreníme. V nádobe elektrického alebo sporákového tlakového hrnca rozpálime na silnom ohni olej, kým práve nezačne dymiť. Vložíme polovicu mäsa v jednej vrstve a bez hýbania opekáme, kým nie je sýto opečené, asi 6 minút. Steaky obrátime a opečieme druhú stranu, ešte 3 až 4 minúty. Steaky preložíme na dosku na krájanie.

3. Do tlakového hrnca pridáme cibuľu a za častého miešania opekáme, kým nie je sklovitá a mäkká, asi 2 minúty. Pridáme cesnak, škoricu, rímsku rascu, nové korenie a oregano a za stáleho miešania opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 1 minútu. Pridáme namočené papričky a kurací vývar a privedieme k miernemu varu. Zmes prelejeme do nádoby mixéra. Mixujeme od najnižšieho stupňa a rýchlosť postupne zvyšujeme na najvyššiu (veko pridržiavame čistou kuchynskou utierkou alebo chňapkou, aby ho para nevyrazila). Mixujeme dohladka, asi 1 minútu. Pyré vrátime do tlakového hrnca.

4. Opečené aj surové steaky z pliecka nakrájame na kúsky 4–5 cm a preložíme do tlakového hrnca. Privedieme k miernemu varu, zľahka osolíme a okoreníme, tlakový hrniec uzavrieme a varíme pod vysokým tlakom 30 minút.

5. Tlak uvoľníme rýchlym ventilom pri elektrickom hrnci alebo pod studenou tečúcou vodou pri sporákovom hrnci. Odstránime veko. Vmiešame rybaciu omáčku, masa harinu (ak ju používame) a ocot. Podľa chuti pridáme štipľavú omáčku. Varíme, kým nezhustne na požadovanú hustotu, asi 5 minút. Podľa chuti osolíme. Najlepšie je nechať chili vychladnúť a uchovať ho v chladničke aspoň cez noc a najviac päť dní. Na druhý deň ho pred podávaním zohrejeme.
6. Podávame ozdobené koriandrovou vňaťou, nasekanou cibuľou, jarnou cibuľkou, strúhaným syrom, avokádom a teplými tortillami podľa chuti.

en.v: This dish is spicy. The chilli heat is part of the original recipe and is kept at the original level, because it is central to the dish. Check the heat before serving.

sk.v: Toto jedlo je pálivé. Pálivosť čili patrí k pôvodnému receptu a zostáva na pôvodnej úrovni, pretože je pre toto jedlo podstatná. Pred podávaním ochutnajte, či vám pálivosť vyhovuje.

en.t: 70 g ghee or olive oil

30 g piece fresh ginger peeled and finely grated
6 garlic cloves peeled and crushed
3 mild green chillies cut at an angle into 1cm-thick slices
4.5 tbsp (67 ml) leaf masala
0.75 tsp (3.5 ml) ground turmeric
225 g cinnamon
3 whole star anise
2 fresh bay leaves
6 large plum tomatoes roughly grated and skins discarded, about 750 g
750 ml chicken stock
Salt
550 g maris piper potatoes about 3-4, peeled and cut into 3 cm chunks
2 carrots peeled and cut into 3 cm chunks, about 150 g
20 g coriander leaves picked and stalks finely chopped
4 soft white bread rolls
30 g ghee or olive oil
4 sprigs fresh curry leaves, about 20 leaves
3 carrots peeled and shaved into ribbons with a peeler, about 200 g
1 small red onion peeled and finely sliced, about 100 g
3 tbsp (44 ml) white-wine vinegar
0.5 garlic clove grated
10 g piece fresh ginger peeled and finely grated
1 tsp (4 g) soft light brown sugar
1 bird’s eye chilli thinly sliced (if you don’t like heat, leave it out)
1 tbsp (15 ml) lime juice
2 tsp (10 ml) olive oil
3 fresh bay leaves stems removed
1 tbsp (15 ml) dried fenugreek leaves
5 tbsp fresh curry leaves about 20 g
2 tbsp (30 ml) coriander seeds
1.5 tbsp (22 ml) cumin seeds
10 g cardamom pods lightly bashed open in a mortar to get 1½ tsp seeds
1 tbsp (15 ml) fennel seeds
1 tsp (5 ml) fenugreek seeds
4 whole cloves
1 cinnamon stick
50 g Kashmiri chilli powder or any other mild chilli powder (source reads "50 tbsp … about 50 g"; the 50 g weight is used)
1 tsp (5 ml) ground ginger
1.5 tsp (7.5 ml) smoked paprika

1. To make the leaf masala, blitz the bay leaves and fenugreek in the small bowl of a food processor or a spice grinder until finely chopped to the size of confetti. Add the curry leaves, pulse about three times, until coarsely broken, then tip out into a medium bowl.

2. Put all the other spices in the food processor and blitz until very well ground. Add the ground spices to the leaves in the bowl, mix well and transfer to an airtight jar. The spice mix will keep for up to 3 months.

3. To start the bunny chow, put a 28 cm-wide, heavy-based casserole pan on a medium-high heat. Heat 35 g ghee until it’s searing hot, then brown the lamb on all sides in two or three batches, so as not to overcrowd the pan. Once seared and nicely coloured, transfer to a medium bowl and repeat with the remaining lamb.

4. Add the remaining 35 g ghee to the pan with the onions and cook, stirring frequently, for 20 minutes, until softened and golden brown. Add the next eight ingredients, stir well and cook for another 3 to 5 minutes, until fragrant.
5. Return the lamb and any juices from the bowl to the pan, then stir in the tomatoes, chicken stock and 1 1/2 tsp salt.

6. Add the potatoes and carrots to the pot, bring up to a hard simmer, then turn the heat down low, cover the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 1/2 hours, until the meat is tender; take off the lid for the last 20 minutes, so the sauce thickens.
7. Leave the curry to sit, uncovered, for 30 minutes, to give the flavours a chance to mingle.
8. Heat the oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C). While the oven’s warming up, make the carrot sambal.
9. Put the carrots, onions, vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, the garlic, ginger, brown sugar and chilli in a bowl, toss to combine, then leave to steep for 30 minutes.
10. Squeeze out the mixture with your hands, to remove as much excess liquid as possible, then mix with the remaining ingredients and the finely chopped coriander stalks.

11. While the carrot mix is pickling, make the curry leaf oil. In a small frying pan, heat the ghee on a medium heat and, once hot, add the curry leaves, fry for about 5 minutes, until dark green, then take off the heat and set aside.

12. Put the bread rolls on a medium oven tray, brush them all over with some of the curry leaf oil, then warm in the oven for 5 minutes. Cut off the tops of the rolls, like giving them little hats, then hollow out the rolls.
13. Spoon in a generous amount of the curry, followed by some of the sambal, a spoonful of the ghee and some curry leaves.
14. Pop the tops of the rolls back on and serve hot with the remaining curry leaves, coriander and condiments on the side.

c.t: 1. To make the leaf masala, blitz the bay leaves and fenugreek in the small bowl of a food processor or a spice grinder until finely chopped to the size of confetti. Add the curry leaves, pulse about three times, until coarsely broken, then tip out into a medium bowl.

2. Put all the other spices in the food processor and blitz until very well ground. Add the ground spices to the leaves in the bowl, mix well and transfer to an airtight jar. The spice mix will keep for up to 3 months.

3. To start the bunny chow, put a 28 cm-wide, heavy-based casserole pan on a medium-high heat. Heat 21 g ghee until it’s searing hot, then brown the lamb on all sides in two or three batches, so as not to overcrowd the pan. Once seared and nicely coloured, transfer to a medium bowl and repeat with the remaining lamb.

4. Add the remaining 21 g ghee to the pan with the onions and cook, stirring frequently, for 20 minutes, until softened and golden brown. Add the next eight ingredients, stir well and cook for another 3 to 5 minutes, until fragrant.
5. Return the lamb and any juices from the bowl to the pan, then stir in the tomatoes, chicken stock and 1 1/2 tsp salt.

6. Add the potatoes and carrots to the pot, bring up to a hard simmer, then turn the heat down low, cover the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 1/2 hours, until the meat is tender; take off the lid for the last 20 minutes, so the sauce thickens.
7. Leave the curry to sit, uncovered, for 30 minutes, to give the flavours a chance to mingle.
8. Heat the oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C). While the oven’s warming up, make the carrot sambal.
9. Put the carrots, onions, vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, the garlic, ginger, brown sugar and chilli in a bowl, toss to combine, then leave to steep for 30 minutes.
10. Squeeze out the mixture with your hands, to remove as much excess liquid as possible, then mix with the remaining ingredients and the finely chopped coriander stalks.

11. While the carrot mix is pickling, make the curry leaf oil. In a small frying pan, heat the ghee on a medium heat and, once hot, add the curry leaves, fry for about 5 minutes, until dark green, then take off the heat and set aside.

12. Put the bread rolls on a medium oven tray, brush them all over with some of the curry leaf oil, then warm in the oven for 5 minutes. Cut off the tops of the rolls, like giving them little hats, then hollow out the rolls.
13. Spoon in a generous amount of the curry, followed by some of the sambal, a spoonful of the ghee and some curry leaves.
14. Pop the tops of the rolls back on and serve hot with the remaining curry leaves, coriander and condiments on the side.

1. Na listovú masalu rozdrvíme bobkové listy a senovku grécku v malej nádobe kuchynského robota alebo v mlynčeku na korenie nadrobno, na veľkosť konfiet. Pridáme kari listy, asi trikrát pulzne premiešame, kým sa nahrubo nepolámu, a vysypeme do strednej misy.

2. Všetky ostatné koreniny dáme do kuchynského robota a veľmi jemne ich pomelieme. Mleté koreniny pridáme k listom v mise, dobre premiešame a preložíme do vzduchotesného pohára. Zmes korenia vydrží až 3 mesiace.

3. Na bunny chow postavíme kastról s hrubým dnom so šírkou 28 cm na stredne silný oheň. Rozpálime 21 g ghí, kým nie je rozpálené dohorúca, potom opečieme jahňacie mäso zo všetkých strán na dva či tri razy, aby sme kastról nepreplnili. Keď je mäso opečené a pekne zafarbené, preložíme ho do strednej misy a zopakujeme so zvyšným mäsom.

4. Do kastróla pridáme zvyšných 21 g ghí s cibuľou a za častého miešania opekáme 20 minút, kým cibuľa nezmäkne a nie je zlatohnedá. Pridáme ďalších osem surovín, dobre premiešame a opekáme ďalšie 3 až 5 minút, kým nezavoňajú.
5. Mäso aj so šťavou z misy vrátime do kastróla a vmiešame paradajky, kurací vývar a 1 1/2 ČL soli.

6. Do hrnca pridáme zemiaky a mrkvu, privedieme do silného varu, potom oheň stlmíme na mierny, kastról prikryjeme a za občasného miešania dusíme 2 1/2 hodiny, kým mäso nie je mäkké; posledných 20 minút dusíme bez pokrievky, aby omáčka zhustla.
7. Kari necháme 30 minút postáť bez pokrievky, aby sa chute prepojili.
8. Rúru rozohrejeme na 220 °C (teplovzdušnú na 200 °C). Kým sa rúra zohrieva, pripravíme mrkvový sambal.
9. Mrkvu, cibuľu, ocot, 1/2 ČL soli, cesnak, zázvor, hnedý cukor a čili dáme do misy, premiešame a necháme 30 minút lúhovať.
10. Zmes rukami vytlačíme, aby sme odstránili čo najviac tekutiny, potom ju zmiešame so zvyšnými surovinami a nadrobno nasekanými stonkami koriandra.

11. Kým sa mrkvová zmes nakladá, pripravíme olej s kari listami. V malej panvici zohrejeme na strednom ohni ghí, a keď je horúce, pridáme kari listy, opekáme ich asi 5 minút, kým nie sú tmavozelené, potom odstavíme z ohňa a odložíme.
12. Žemle položíme na stredný plech, celé ich potrieme trochou oleja s kari listami a zohrejeme v rúre 5 minút. Odrežeme z nich vrchy ako malé klobúčiky a žemle vydlabeme.
13. Naplníme ich štedrou dávkou kari, potom trochou sambalu, lyžičkou ghí a niekoľkými kari listami.
14. Vrchy žemlí vrátime späť a podávame horúce so zvyšnými kari listami, koriandrom a prílohami nabok.

en.v: Harissa can be cooled to room temperature and refrigerated for up to three days before reheating on the stovetop; add water, 1 tbsp (15 ml) at a time, to restore it to its original consistency.

sk.v: Harissu môžeme nechať vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu a uchovávať v chladničke až tri dni, potom ju ohrejeme na sporáku; po 1 PL (15 ml) pridávame vodu, kým nezíska pôvodnú hustotu.

c.t: Do not trim fat or sinew from the meat; it adds flavour and richness and breaks down completely.
Korkot (hulled wheat) is ideal if you find it; pearled farro is an excellent substitute, and pearled barley also works.
In a pressure cooker add only 235 ml water (not the 475 ml of the stovetop version); on the stovetop, stir more often after the first hour to prevent sticking and scorching.
Aleppo pepper is quite mild, with a raisin-like sweetness; it is sold in Middle Eastern markets and online. Gochugaru, or paprika plus 1/8 tsp cayenne, can be substituted.
Z mäsa neodkrajujte tuk ani šľachy; dodajú chuť a plnosť a úplne sa rozvaria.
Ak zoženiete korkot (lúpanú pšenicu), použite ho; výbornou náhradou je lúpaný farro (pšenica dvojzrnná) a funguje aj lúpaný jačmeň (krúpy).
V tlakovom hrnci pridajte len 235 ml vody (nie 475 ml ako na sporáku); na sporáku po prvej hodine miešajte častejšie, aby sa nepripálilo.
Aleppské korenie je dosť jemné, s hrozienkovou sladkosťou; dostanete ho v blízkovýchodných obchodoch a online. Nahradiť ho môžete gočugaru alebo sladkou paprikou s 1/8 ČL kajenského korenia.

en.t: 960 ml homemade or store-bought chicken stock
455 g boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut in half crosswise, or boneless lamb stew meat, cut into 2.5 cm cubes
276 g pearled farro
1 tsp (3 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt
6 tbsp (85 g) butter
4 tbsp (60 g) olive oil
2 tbsp (16 g) Aleppo pepper
lavash, for serving (optional)

1. For the Stovetop: Combine broth, 480 ml water, chicken (or lamb), farro, and salt in a Dutch oven and bring to boil over high heat. Cover pot and reduce heat to maintain gentle simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mixture is creamy and thick and grains easily compress under a spatula, 1 1/2 to 2 hours. You will need to stir more frequently toward the end of the cooking process. Skip to step 4. For a Pressure Cooker: Place broth, 240 ml water, chicken (or lamb or beef), farro, and salt in a pressure cooker. Seal and bring to high pressure over medium-high heat, if using a stovetop model, or by setting to pressure-cooker mode on an electric multi-cooker. Cook at high pressure for 40 minutes, adjusting heat as needed to maintain high pressure (if using a stovetop pressure cooker; electric ones will automatically regulate the heat and pressure level).
2. Allow cooker to depressurize naturally (about 15 minutes), then carefully remove lid, allowing steam to escape away from you.

3. Using a potato masher, vigorously mash mixture until the majority of chicken pieces are reduced to fine shreds and the harissa is very thick and starchy, about 2 minutes. (If you have an immersion blender, you can speed things along by blending the mixture for about 30 seconds and then finishing with potato masher.) Season with additional salt to taste.

4. In a small saucepan, heat butter and oil over medium-high heat until foamy. Continue to cook, swirling pan, until milk solids in butter turn a deep hazelnut brown, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add Aleppo pepper (don't be alarmed; butter will foam and fizzle when pepper is added), swirling to coat.
5. Spoon harissa into bowls, drizzle with spiced brown butter, and serve (with lavash on side, if including).

1. Na sporáku: vývar, 480 ml vody, kuracie (alebo jahňacie) mäso, farro a soľ dáme do liatinového hrnca a na silnom ohni privedieme do varu. Hrniec prikryjeme a oheň stlmíme, aby sa udržal mierny var. Varíme za občasného miešania, kým zmes nie je krémová a hustá a zrná sa pod stierkou ľahko stlačia, 1 1/2 až 2 hodiny. Ku koncu varenia budeme musieť miešať častejšie. Prejdeme na krok 4. V tlakovom hrnci: vývar, 240 ml vody, kuracie (alebo jahňacie či hovädzie) mäso, farro a soľ dáme do tlakového hrnca. Uzavrieme a pri sporákovom modeli privedieme na stredne silnom ohni na vysoký tlak, pri elektrickom multifunkčnom hrnci nastavíme režim tlakového varenia. Varíme pod vysokým tlakom 40 minút a podľa potreby upravujeme oheň, aby sa udržal vysoký tlak (pri sporákovom tlakovom hrnci; elektrické regulujú teplotu a tlak automaticky).
2. Necháme hrniec samovoľne uvoľniť tlak (asi 15 minút), potom opatrne odstránime veko tak, aby para unikala smerom od nás.

3. Zmes energicky roztlačíme štuchadlom na zemiaky, kým sa väčšina kuracieho mäsa nerozpadne na jemné vlákna a harees nie je veľmi hustý a škrobovitý, asi 2 minúty. (Ak máme ponorný mixér, môžeme si pomôcť tak, že zmes asi 30 sekúnd rozmixujeme a dokončíme štuchadlom.) Podľa chuti dosolíme.

4. V malom hrnci zohrejeme na stredne silnom ohni maslo s olejom, kým nespenia. Zohrievame ďalej a krúžime hrncom, kým mliečne bielkoviny v masle nie sú sýto orieškovo hnedé, 1 až 2 minúty. Odstavíme z ohňa a pridáme papriku Aleppo (nezľakneme sa; maslo po pridaní papriky spení a zasyčí) a krúžime, aby sa obalila.

c.t: Do not substitute hot, half-sharp or smoked paprika for the sweet paprika, and use a fresh container. Any boneless chuck roast works. Cook in a Dutch oven with a tight lid (or put foil under the lid). The stew keeps covered in the refrigerator for up to 2 days: skim the hardened fat, thin with a little water, reheat, and only then add the optional sour cream. Serve over boiled potatoes or egg noodles.

Sladkú papriku nenahrádzajte pálivou, polopálivou ani údenou a použite čerstvé balenie. Poslúži akýkoľvek vykostený kus z hovädzej krkovičky. Varte v liatinovom hrnci s tesnou pokrievkou (alebo pod pokrievku dajte alobal). Guláš vydrží zakrytý v chladničke najviac 2 dni: zoberte stuhnutý tuk, zrieďte trochou vody, prihrejte a až potom pridajte nepovinnú kyslú smotanu. Podávajte s varenými zemiakmi alebo vaječnými rezancami.

en.t: 1 (1590–1810 g) boneless beef chuck-eye roast, trimmed of excess fat and cut into 4 cm cubes
Salt
79 ml sweet paprika
1 (340 g) jar roasted red peppers, drained and rinsed (about 235 ml)
2 tbsp (30 ml) tomato paste
3 tsp (15 ml) white vinegar
2 tbsp (30 ml) vegetable oil
4 large onions, diced small (about 1420 ml)
4 large carrots, peeled and cut into 2.5 cm-thick rounds (about 475 ml)
1 bay leaf
235 ml beef broth, warmed
57 g sour cream (optional)
ground black pepper

1. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and heat oven to 165 °C (fan 145 °C). Sprinkle meat evenly with 1 tsp (5 ml) salt and let stand 15 minutes. Process paprika, roasted peppers, tomato paste, and 2 tsp (10 ml) vinegar in food processor until smooth, 1 to 2 minutes, scraping down sides as needed.

2. Combine oil, onions, and 1 tsp (5 ml) salt in large Dutch oven; cover and set over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions soften but have not yet begun to brown, 8 to 10 minutes. (If onions begin to brown, reduce heat to medium-low and stir in 1 tbsp (15 ml) water.)

3. Stir in paprika mixture; cook, stirring occasionally, until onions stick to bottom of pan, about 2 minutes. Add beef, carrots, and bay leaf; stir until beef is well coated. Using rubber spatula, scrape down sides of pot. Cover pot and transfer to oven. Cook until meat is almost tender and surface of liquid is 1.5 cm below top of meat, 2 to 2½ hours, stirring every 30 minutes. Remove pot from oven and add enough beef broth so that surface of liquid is 0.5 cm from top of meat (beef should not be fully submerged). Return covered pot to oven and continue to cook until fork slips easily in and out of beef, about 30 minutes longer.
4. Skim fat off surface; stir in remaining tsp vinegar and sour cream, if using. Remove bay leaf, adjust seasonings with salt and pepper, and serve.

c.t: 1. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and heat oven to 165 °C (fan 145 °C). Sprinkle meat evenly with 1 tsp (5 ml) salt and let stand 15 minutes. Process paprika, roasted peppers, tomato paste, and 2 tsp (10 ml) vinegar in food processor until smooth, 1 to 2 minutes, scraping down sides as needed.

2. Combine oil, onions, and 1 tsp (5 ml) salt in large Dutch oven; cover and set over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions soften but have not yet begun to brown, 8 to 10 minutes. (If onions begin to brown, reduce heat to medium-low and stir in 1 tbsp (15 ml) water.)

3. Stir in paprika mixture; cook, stirring occasionally, until onions stick to bottom of pan, about 2 minutes. Add beef, carrots, and bay leaf; stir until beef is well coated. Using rubber spatula, scrape down sides of pot. Cover pot and transfer to oven. Cook until meat is almost tender and surface of liquid is 1.5 cm below top of meat, 2 to 2½ hours, stirring every 30 minutes. Remove pot from oven and add enough beef broth so that surface of liquid is 0.5 cm from top of meat (beef should not be fully submerged). Return covered pot to oven and continue to cook until fork slips easily in and out of beef, about 30 minutes longer.
4. Skim fat off surface; stir in remaining tsp vinegar and sour cream, if using. Remove bay leaf, adjust seasonings with salt and pepper, and serve.

1. Rošt v rúre posunieme do dolnej strednej polohy a rúru rozohrejeme na 165 °C (teplovzdušnú na 145 °C). Mäso rovnomerne posypeme 1 ČL (5 ml) soli a necháme 15 minút postáť. Papriku (mletú), pečené papriky, paradajkový pretlak a 2 ČL (10 ml) octu rozmixujeme v kuchynskom robote dohladka, 1 až 2 minúty; podľa potreby zotierame steny.

2. Vo veľkom liatinovom hrnci spojíme olej, cibuľu a 1 ČL (5 ml) soli; prikryjeme a postavíme na stredný oheň. Za občasného miešania dusíme, kým cibuľa nezmäkne, ale ešte nezačne hnednúť, 8 až 10 minút. (Ak začne cibuľa hnednúť, stlmíme oheň na stredne mierny a vmiešame 1 PL (15 ml) vody.)

3. Vmiešame paprikovú zmes; za občasného miešania dusíme, kým sa cibuľa nezačne lepiť na dno, asi 2 minúty. Pridáme mäso, mrkvu a bobkový list; miešame, kým sa mäso dobre neobalí. Gumenou stierkou zotrieme steny hrnca. Hrniec prikryjeme a vložíme do rúry. Dusíme, kým mäso nie je takmer mäkké a hladina tekutiny je 1,5 cm pod vrchom mäsa, 2 až 2½ hodiny; každých 30 minút premiešame. Hrniec vyberieme z rúry a prilejeme toľko hovädzieho vývaru, aby bola hladina tekutiny 0,5 cm pod vrchom mäsa (mäso nemá byť úplne ponorené). Prikrytý hrniec vrátime do rúry a dusíme ďalej, kým vidlička ľahko nevkĺzne do mäsa a nevykĺzne z neho, ešte asi 30 minút.
4. Z povrchu zoberieme tuk; vmiešame zvyšnú ČL octu a kyslú smotanu, ak ju používame. Vyberieme bobkový list, dochutíme soľou a korením a podávame.

time.en: 5 min | Cook: not given | Total: not given

en.t: Thick-cut beef steak(s), at least 4–5 cm thick, such as ribeye, strip, porterhouse, T-bone, tri-tip, or filet mignon
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
Vegetable oil (if finishing on the stovetop)
1 tbsp (15 g) butter (if finishing on the stovetop)

1. Generously season steak(s) all over with salt and pepper. If desired, set steak(s) on a wire rack set in a rimmed baking sheet and refrigerate, uncovered, overnight to dry out the exterior. Otherwise, proceed with the next step.

2. If Cooking in the Oven: Set steak(s) on a wire rack set in a rimmed baking sheet. Preheat oven to anywhere between 93 and 135 °C (fan 115 °C); if your oven goes lower, you can set it to an even lower temperature, though it will take longer to cook.

3. Place steak(s) in the oven and cook until an instant-read thermometer registers 41 °C for rare, 46 °C for medium-rare, 52 °C for medium, or 57 °C for medium-well. This will take about 20 minutes for rare steak and up to about 40 minutes for medium-well; cooking time can vary dramatically depending on many factors, so check often.

4. Just before steak(s) come out of the oven, add 1 tbsp (15 ml) oil to a cast iron, carbon steel, or heavy stainless steel skillet and heat over high heat until smoking. Add steak(s) and butter to skillet and cook until each side is well browned, about 45 seconds per side. Using tongs, hold steak(s) sideways to sear edges. Serve right away; there's no need to let reverse-seared steaks rest.

5. If Cooking on the Grill: Light one chimney full of charcoal. When all the charcoal is lit and covered with gray ash, pour out and spread the coals evenly over half of coal grate. Alternatively, set half the burners of a gas grill to high heat. Set cooking grate in place, cover grill, and allow to preheat for 5 minutes. Clean and oil grilling grate.

6. Set steak(s) on cooler side of grill and let cook uncovered, turning occasionally, until an instant-read thermometer registers 41 °C for rare, 46 °C for medium-rare, 52 °C for medium, or 57 °C for medium-well. Cooking time can vary greatly, so check the steaks often.

7. Transfer steak(s) to a platter and tent with foil. If you are using a charcoal grill and your coals have died down, build up the biggest fire you can. If using a gas grill, make sure all burners are turned to their highest heat and allow the grill to preheat with the lid closed.
8. Return steak(s) to the hottest part of the grill and cook, turning frequently, until crisp and charred all over, about 1 1/2 minutes total. Serve right away.

maslo bez laktózy alebo ghí; množstvo znížené na 70 % — vlastná úprava

1. Steak(y) zo všetkých strán výdatne osolíme a okoreníme. Ak chceme, položíme ich na mriežku vloženú do plechu s okrajom a necháme ich cez noc odkryté v chladničke, aby povrch vyschol. Inak pokračujeme ďalším krokom.

2. Príprava v rúre: steak(y) položíme na mriežku vloženú do plechu s okrajom. Rúru rozohrejeme na teplotu od 93 do 135 °C (teplovzdušnú na 115 °C); ak sa dá rúra nastaviť nižšie, môžeme zvoliť aj nižšiu teplotu, príprava však potrvá dlhšie.

3. Steak(y) vložíme do rúry a pečieme, kým vpichový teplomer neukáže 41 °C pre krvavý (rare), 46 °C pre medium-rare, 52 °C pre medium alebo 57 °C pre medium-well. Pri krvavom steaku to trvá asi 20 minút, pri medium-well až asi 40 minút; čas sa môže výrazne líšiť v závislosti od mnohých faktorov, preto často kontrolujeme.

4. Tesne predtým, ako steak(y) vyberieme z rúry, nalejeme 1 PL (15 ml) oleja do liatinovej, oceľovej alebo hrubostennej nerezovej panvice a rozpálime na silnom ohni, kým nezačne dymiť. Pridáme steak(y) a maslo a opekáme, kým nie je každá strana dobre opečená, asi 45 sekúnd z každej strany. Kliešťami pridržíme steak(y) bokom a opečieme aj okraje. Hneď podávame; steaky pripravené metódou reverse sear netreba nechať odpočívať.

5. Príprava na grile: zapálime jeden plný komín (podpaľovač) dreveného uhlia. Keď je všetko uhlie rozžeravené a pokryté sivým popolom, vysypeme ho a rovnomerne rozprestrieme na polovicu roštu na uhlie. Prípadne na plynovom grile nastavíme polovicu horákov na vysoký výkon. Vložíme grilovací rošt, gril prikryjeme a necháme 5 minút rozohriať. Grilovací rošt očistíme a natrieme olejom.

6. Steak(y) položíme na chladnejšiu stranu grilu a grilujeme bez pokrievky, občas obrátime, kým vpichový teplomer neukáže 41 °C pre krvavý (rare), 46 °C pre medium-rare, 52 °C pre medium alebo 57 °C pre medium-well. Čas sa môže veľmi líšiť, preto steaky často kontrolujeme.

7. Steak(y) preložíme na tanier a voľne prikryjeme alobalom. Ak používame gril na drevené uhlie a uhlie už dohorieva, rozdúchame čo najväčší oheň. Ak používame plynový gril, nastavíme všetky horáky na najvyšší výkon a gril necháme so zatvoreným vekom rozohriať.
8. Steak(y) vrátime na najhorúcejšiu časť grilu a grilujeme za častého obracania, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán chrumkavé a pripečené, spolu asi 1 1/2 minúty. Hneď podávame.

time.en: 5 min | Cook: 30 min | Total: 40 min

en.v: 30 cm stainless-steel, cast iron, or carbon steel skillet, tongs

sk.v: Nerezová 30 cm, liatinová, alebo panvica z uhlíkovej ocele, kliešte

en.t: Two 4-bone racks of lamb
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 tbsp (15 ml) vegetable or canola oil
4 tbsp (60 g) unsalted butter
2 medium cloves garlic
A few fresh thyme sprigs

1. Season the racks all over with salt and pepper. If you have more than 1 hour and up to 24 hours before you need to serve the lamb, set the racks uncovered on a wire rack set in a rimmed baking sheet and refrigerate until ready to cook. If not, proceed immediately to cooking.

2. In a large stainless-steel, cast iron, or carbon steel skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add racks meaty side down and cook until lightly browned, about 2 minutes. Using tongs, turn racks meaty side up and cook until lightly browned on the underside, about 2 minutes (the ribs curve, so the underside won't make complete contact with the pan). Stand the racks, so the bones are pointing upwards, and sear so that the underside is lightly browned (you may need to lean the racks against each other to keep them from falling).

3. Add butter, garlic, and thyme to the pan and let melt. Lower heat to medium and cook the lamb, flipping the racks often and basting constantly with the hot butter, until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the eye of the loin registers 54 °C for medium-rare or 57 °C for medium, about 20 minutes (though please note that the cooking time will vary heavily depending on the size of the racks, which range from quite small to big and meaty); make sure to spend some time basting the ribs side of the racks so that they cook there too.
4. Let rest 5 minutes, then carve into individual chops and serve.

1. Jahňacie karé zo všetkých strán osolíme a okoreníme. Ak máme do podávania viac ako 1 hodinu a najviac 24 hodín, položíme karé odkryté na mriežku vloženú do plechu s okrajom a necháme v chladničke až do prípravy. Ak nie, hneď pokračujeme v príprave.

2. Vo veľkej nerezovej, liatinovej alebo oceľovej panvici zohrejeme na stredne silnom ohni olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Karé vložíme mäsitou stranou nadol a opekáme, kým zľahka nezhnedne, asi 2 minúty. Kliešťami karé obrátime mäsitou stranou nahor a opekáme, kým spodná strana zľahka nezhnedne, asi 2 minúty (rebrá sú zakrivené, takže spodná strana sa panvice celá nedotkne). Karé postavíme tak, aby kosti smerovali nahor, a opečieme, aby spodok zľahka zhnedol (karé možno budeme musieť oprieť o seba, aby nespadli).

3. Do panvice pridáme maslo, cesnak a tymián a necháme maslo roztopiť. Oheň stlmíme na stredný a jahňacie mäso opekáme, karé často obraciame a neustále polievame horúcim maslom, kým vpichový teplomer zapichnutý do stredu chrbta neukáže 54 °C pre medium-rare alebo 57 °C pre medium, asi 20 minút (čas sa však výrazne líši podľa veľkosti karé, ktoré môže byť od celkom malého až po veľké a mäsité); nezabudneme polievať aj stranu s rebrami, aby sa mäso prepieklo aj tam.
4. Necháme 5 minút odpočívať, potom nakrájame na jednotlivé kotlety a podávame.

1. Jahňacie mäso: vo veľkom liatinovom hrnci alebo hrnci s hrubým dnom zohrejeme na stredne miernom ohni olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme cibuľu, prikryjeme a za občasného miešania dusíme, kým cibuľa nie je mäkká a sklovitá, 10 až 15 minút.
2. Pridáme cesnak, kurkumu, zázvor, koriander, soľ a korenie a za občasného miešania opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 3 minúty.

3. Pridáme kúsky jahňacieho mäsa a premiešame s cibuľou a koreninami, potom prilejeme vývar a pridáme zväzok koriandrovej vňate. Oheň zvýšime na stredne silný a privedieme do varu, potom hrniec prikryjeme, oheň stlmíme na mierny a dusíme; oheň podľa potreby upravujeme, aby sa udržal jemný var, a každých 30 minút premiešame, aby sa omáčka neprichytila na dno, kým mäso nie je mäkké a pri stlačení vidličkou sa ľahko neoddeľuje, 2 až 2 1/2 hodiny. Omáčka môže počas varenia mierne zhustnúť, v hrnci však nesmie byť sucho; ak treba, prilievame po 1 PL (15 ml) vývar alebo vodu, kým v hrnci nie je aspoň 1,3 cm omáčky. Podľa chuti osolíme.

4. Karamelizované sušené slivky: keď je mäso hotové, v strednom kastróliku spojíme sušené slivky, zeleninový vývar, med, olivový olej, škoricu, soľ a korenie a na stredne miernom ohni privedieme k miernemu varu. Jemne varíme, kým omáčka mierne nezhustne na tmavý sirup, asi 7 minút. Podľa chuti osolíme.

5. Podávanie: z jahňacieho mäsa vyberieme zväzok koriandrovej vňate. Jahňací tagine preložíme do servírovacej misy a navrch rozložíme slivky so sirupom. Ozdobíme opraženými sezamovými semienkami a lístkami koriandra. Podávame s chlebom, kuskusom alebo ryžou podľa výberu.

1. For the pickles: Whisk vinegar, sugar, and salt together in medium bowl. Add daikon and toss to combine. Gently press on daikon to submerge. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 24 hours.
2. For the chile sauce: Combine all ingredients in small bowl. Cover and set aside. (Sauce can be refrigerated for up to 3 days.)

3. For the beef: Place beef on large plate and freeze until very firm, 35 to 40 minutes. Once firm, stand each piece on 1 cut side on cutting board and, using sharp knife, shave beef against grain as thin as possible. (Slices needn't be perfectly intact.) Combine water and baking soda in medium bowl. Add beef and toss to coat. Let sit at room temperature for 5 minutes.

4. Meanwhile, process onion, sugar, soy sauce, garlic, sesame oil, and pepper in food processor until smooth, about 30 seconds, scraping down sides of bowl as needed. Add onion mixture to beef and toss to evenly coat.

5. Heat vegetable oil in 30 cm nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add beef mixture in even layer and cook, without stirring, until browned on 1 side, about 1 minute. Stir and continue to cook until beef is no longer pink, 3 to 4 minutes longer. Add scallion greens and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Transfer to platter. Serve with pickles and chile sauce.

1. Nakladaná reďkev: v strednej mise metličkou zmiešame ocot, cukor a soľ. Pridáme reďkev daikon a premiešame. Reďkev jemne pritlačíme, aby bola ponorená. Prikryjeme a necháme v chladničke aspoň 30 minút alebo až 24 hodín.
2. Čili omáčka: všetky suroviny spojíme v malej miske. Prikryjeme a odložíme. (Omáčka vydrží v chladničke až 3 dni.)

3. Hovädzie mäso: mäso položíme na veľký tanier a dáme do mrazničky, kým nie je veľmi pevné, 35 až 40 minút. Keď stuhne, každý kúsok postavíme na jednu reznú stranu na dosku na krájanie a ostrým nožom krájame mäso naprieč vláknami čo najtenšie. (Plátky nemusia byť úplne celé.) V strednej mise zmiešame vodu a jedlú sódu. Pridáme mäso a premiešame, aby sa obalilo. Necháme 5 minút postáť pri izbovej teplote.

4. Medzitým v kuchynskom robote rozmixujeme cibuľu, cukor, sójovú omáčku, cesnak, sezamový olej a korenie dohladka, asi 30 sekúnd; podľa potreby zotierame steny nádoby. Cibuľovú zmes pridáme k mäsu a premiešame, aby sa rovnomerne obalilo.

5. V 30 cm nepriľnavej panvici zohrejeme na stredne silnom ohni rastlinný olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme mäsovú zmes v rovnomernej vrstve a bez miešania opekáme, kým z jednej strany nezhnedne, asi 1 minútu. Premiešame a opekáme ďalej, kým mäso už nie je ružové, ešte 3 až 4 minúty. Pridáme zelené časti jarnej cibuľky a za stáleho miešania opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 30 sekúnd. Preložíme na tanier. Podávame s nakladanou reďkvou a čili omáčkou.

1. For the Shawarma Spice Blend: On a cutting board, use the flat side of a knife to crush cardamom pods. Carefully extract seeds; discard pods.

2. In a medium skillet, toast black peppercorns, allspice berry, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, and cardamom seeds over medium heat, tossing constantly, until fragrant, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Transfer toasted spices to a bowl and let cool slightly, about 5 minutes.

3. In spice grinder or a mortar and pestle, combine toasted spices with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, dried oregano, ground sumac, turmeric, red pepper flakes or Aleppo pepper, and ground cinnamon. Grind to a fine powder; set aside.

4. For the Marinade: In the bowl of a food processor, purée onion until smooth. Using a fine-mesh sieve set over a large bowl, strain puréed onion, using a spoon or flexible spatula to press pulp to extract juice. Add yogurt, vinegar, lime juice, olive oil, garlic, 2 tbsp (30 ml) shawarma spice blend, and salt, whisking to combine. Add sliced steak, using your hands to massage and toss beef to evenly coat in marinade. Cover bowl with a large plate or plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or up to 8 hours.

5. For the Tahini Sauce: In a medium bowl, whisk tahini, yogurt, lime juice, salt, and pepper to combine; sauce should be smooth and spreadable. If sauce is too thick, add warm water, 1 tbsp (15 ml) at a time, until sauce is thick but spreadable. Refrigerate until ready to use.

6. For the Shawarma: When ready to cook, remove beef from fridge. Using tongs, remove beef from marinade, letting any excess marinade drip back into the bowl, and set on a large plate. Let beef come to room temperature, about 20 minutes.

7. In a large cast iron, carbon steel, or stainless steel skillet, melt liyeh (lamb fat) over medium-high heat. When lamb fat is melted, fragrant, and shimmering, add beef in a single layer, cooking in batches as needed to prevent the beef from overcooking. Cook, stirring occasionally, until beef is browned, 5 to 7 minutes per batch. Adjust seasoning to taste. Repeat with remaining beef, adjusting heat as necessary to keep skillet hot. Return cooked beef to pan, add tomatoes and onions, and cook until they soften slightly, about 2 minutes. Remove pan from heat and stir in chopped parsley.

8. Set aside a piece of aluminum foil large enough to cover a small saucepan. In small saucepan, heat 1 tbsp (15 ml) oil over high heat until hot and shimmering, about 2 minutes. Heat a piece of charcoal using a long-handled lighter or by holding it over the flame of your gas stove, until it turns gray on the edges, 1 to 2 minutes. Using tongs, place the hot charcoal in a small heatproof dish, such as a ceramic ramekin or a small bowl made of foil, and nestle it in the center of the skillet with the cooked shawarma. Carefully pour hot oil over the charcoal (it will release smoke immediately). Using aluminum foil, immediately tightly cover skillet to trap the smoke, and let beef "smoke" for 15 to 20 minutes in a turned-off oven.

9. To Assemble: Spread bread with tahini sauce and harissa, if using, followed by pickled cucumbers and turnips. Top with about 120 ml shawarma. Serve with french fries, if desired, and extra tahini sauce and pickles.

1. Zmes korenia na shawarmu: na doske na krájanie rozdrvíme plochou stranou noža struky kardamónu. Opatrne vyberieme semienka; struky vyhodíme.

2. V strednej panvici opražíme na strednom ohni čierne korenie, nové korenie, rímsku rascu, koriandrové semienka a semienka kardamónu za stáleho prehadzovania, kým nezavoňajú, 30 sekúnd až 1 minútu. Opražené korenie preložíme do misky a necháme mierne vychladnúť, asi 5 minút.

3. V mlynčeku na korenie alebo v mažiari spojíme opražené korenie s mletou paprikou, cesnakovým práškom, cibuľovým práškom, sušeným oreganom, mletým sumachom, kurkumou, drvenými čili vločkami alebo paprikou Aleppo a mletou škoricou. Pomelieme na jemný prášok; odložíme.

4. Marináda: v nádobe kuchynského robota rozmixujeme cibuľu dohladka. Cibuľové pyré preceďme cez jemné sitko položené nad veľkou misou a lyžicou alebo pružnou stierkou pretlačíme dužinu, aby sme získali šťavu. Pridáme jogurt, ocot, limetkovú šťavu, olivový olej, cesnak, 2 PL (30 ml) zmesi korenia na shawarmu a soľ a metličkou premiešame. Pridáme nakrájaný steak a rukami mäso premasírujeme a premiešame, aby sa rovnomerne obalilo marinádou. Misu prikryjeme veľkým tanierom alebo potravinovou fóliou a necháme v chladničke aspoň 3 hodiny alebo až 8 hodín.

5. Tahini omáčka: v strednej mise metličkou zmiešame tahini, jogurt, limetkovú šťavu, soľ a korenie; omáčka má byť hladká a natierateľná. Ak je príliš hustá, prilievame po 1 PL (15 ml) teplú vodu, kým nie je hustá, ale natierateľná. Necháme v chladničke až do použitia.

6. Shawarma: keď sme pripravení variť, vyberieme mäso z chladničky. Kliešťami ho vyberieme z marinády, necháme prebytočnú marinádu odkvapkať späť do misy a položíme ho na veľký tanier. Necháme mäso zohriať na izbovú teplotu, asi 20 minút.

7. Vo veľkej liatinovej, oceľovej alebo nerezovej panvici roztopíme na stredne silnom ohni liyeh (jahňací loj). Keď je loj roztopený, voňavý a lesklý, pridáme mäso v jednej vrstve; podľa potreby po dávkach, aby sa mäso neprepieklo. Za občasného miešania opekáme, kým mäso nezhnedne, 5 až 7 minút na dávku. Podľa chuti dochutíme. Zopakujeme so zvyšným mäsom a oheň podľa potreby upravujeme, aby panvica zostala horúca. Opečené mäso vrátime do panvice, pridáme paradajky a cibuľu a opekáme, kým mierne nezmäknú, asi 2 minúty. Panvicu odstavíme z ohňa a vmiešame nasekanú petržlenovú vňať.

8. Pripravíme si kus alobalu dostatočne veľký na prikrytie malého kastróla. V malom kastróliku rozpálime na silnom ohni 1¾ ČL (9 ml) oleja, kým nie je horúci a nezačne sa lesknúť, asi 2 minúty. Kúsok dreveného uhlia rozžeravíme dlhým zapaľovačom alebo nad plameňom plynového sporáka, kým na okrajoch nezosivie, 1 až 2 minúty. Kliešťami vložíme horúce uhlie do malej žiaruvzdornej nádobky, napríklad keramickej zapekacej misky alebo malej misky z alobalu, a postavíme ju do stredu panvice s hotovou shawarmou. Na uhlie opatrne nalejeme horúci olej (okamžite začne dymiť). Panvicu hneď tesne prikryjeme alobalom, aby sa dym zachytil, a necháme mäso „údiť“ 15 až 20 minút vo vypnutej rúre.

9. Skladanie: chlieb natrieme tahini omáčkou a podľa chuti harissou, potom pridáme nakladané uhorky a repu. Navrch dáme asi 120 ml shawarmy. Podľa chuti podávame s hranolčekmi a ďalšou tahini omáčkou a nakladanou zeleninou.

en.t: 454 g veal top round, prepared into 2–4 cutlets (see Step 1 below), or 2–4 thinly pounded, prepared veal cutlets
Kosher salt
Neutral oil, clarified butter, lard, or some combination, for frying
120 g all-purpose flour
6 large eggs, beaten
115 g light, very fine breadcrumbs
Lemon wedges, for serving
Erdäpfelsalat (Austrian-Style Potato Salad), for serving (optional)
Cranberry sauce, for serving (optional)

1. If preparing the cutlets yourself: Using a long, sharp knife, and slicing across the grain, cut veal into a 0.5 cm slab, slicing all the way through if making 4 smaller cutlets or leaving it attached at the base if cutting 2 larger ones; if cutting larger ones, then slice a second 0.5 cm-thick slab to form a butterflied cutlet. Repeat to form remaining cutlets.

2. Cut open 2 sides of a 3790 ml zipper-lock bag. Working 1 cutlet at a time, sandwich between the zipper-lock bag flaps and, using the flat side of a meat pounder, pound all over, working from the center towards the edges, until cutlet is about 0.5 cm (2–3 mm) thick. Season pounded cutlet all over top side with salt, then transfer to a platter or rimmed baking sheet and salt other side. Repeat with remaining cutlet(s).

3. Set a wire rack in a rimmed baking sheet and line with paper towels. Fill a vessel that's wide and deep enough to fit 1 pounded cutlet at a time, such as a wok, cast-iron skillet, or sauté pan, with at least 2 cm of oil, clarified butter, and/or lard and heat to 200 °C. While the fat heats, fill 3 wide platters, baking dishes, or rimmed baking sheets with the flour, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs, respectively. Working with 1 cutlet at a time and using 2 hands to prevent it from ripping while handling, dredge cutlet all over in an even layer of flour, gently shaking off excess. Then dredge in the egg, ensuring a thorough and even coating. Finally, lift the cutlet and let the excess egg drip off, then dredge in the breadcrumbs, ensuring an even coating but avoiding pressing the breadcrumbs firmly into the meat (this can make them stick to it and reduce the desired puffing).

4. Immediately and carefully lower cutlet into hot oil and fry, gently swirling the pan (be very careful not to slosh hot fat out) and spooning hot oil all over the top side of the cutlet, until golden brown on the bottom, 1 to 2 minutes. Using tongs and a slotted metal spatula, carefully flip the cutlet and fry until golden brown on second side, 1 to 2 minutes longer. Carefully lift schnitzel from oil, allowing excess oil to drain, and transfer to prepared paper towels to drain.
5. Repeat dredging and frying with remaining cutlets, being careful to maintain the oil's temperature as you work.
6. Transfer the schnitzel to plates and serve with lemon wedges, with Austrian potato salad alongside, if desired.

Finally, lift the cutlet and let the excess egg drip off, then dredge in the breadcrumbs, ensuring an even coating but avoiding pressing the breadcrumbs firmly into the meat (this can make them stick to it and reduce the desired puffing).

4. Immediately and carefully lower cutlet into hot oil and fry, gently swirling the pan (be very careful not to slosh hot fat out) and spooning hot oil all over the top side of the cutlet, until golden brown on the bottom, 1 to 2 minutes. Using tongs and a slotted metal spatula, carefully flip the cutlet and fry until golden brown on second side, 1 to 2 minutes longer. Carefully lift schnitzel from oil, allowing excess oil to drain, and transfer to prepared paper towels to drain.
5. Repeat dredging and frying with remaining cutlets, being careful to maintain the oil's temperature as you work.
6. Transfer the schnitzel to plates and serve with lemon wedges, with Austrian potato salad alongside, if desired.

1. Ak si rezne pripravujeme sami: dlhým ostrým nožom krájame teľacie mäso naprieč vláknami na plát hrubý 0,5 cm; ak robíme 4 menšie rezne, prekrojíme ho celý, ak robíme 2 väčšie, necháme ho pri základni spojený a odkrojíme druhý plát hrubý 0,5 cm, aby vznikol rozložený (motýlikový) rezeň. Zopakujeme so zvyšnými rezňami.

2. Rozstrihneme 2 strany 3,79-litrového uzatvárateľného vrecka. Rezne spracúvame po jednom: vložíme rezeň medzi dve časti vrecka a plochou stranou paličky na mäso ho celý vyklepeme, od stredu k okrajom, kým nie je hrubý asi 0,5 cm (2–3 mm). Vyklepaný rezeň osolíme po celej hornej strane, preložíme na tanier alebo plech s okrajom a osolíme druhú stranu. Zopakujeme so zvyšnými rezňami.

3. Do plechu s okrajom vložíme mriežku a vystelieme ju papierovými utierkami. Nádobu dostatočne širokú a hlbokú na jeden vyklepaný rezeň, napríklad wok, liatinovú panvicu alebo hlbokú panvicu, naplníme aspoň 2 cm oleja a/alebo prepusteného masla a zohrejeme na 200 °C. Kým sa tuk zohrieva, naplníme 3 široké taniere, zapekacie misy alebo plechy s okrajom postupne múkou, rozšľahanými vajcami a strúhankou. Rezne spracúvame po jednom a pridržiavame ich oboma rukami, aby sa neroztrhli: rezeň obalíme rovnomernou vrstvou múky a jemne straseme prebytok. Potom ho obalíme vo vajci tak, aby bol dôkladne a rovnomerne pokrytý. Nakoniec rezeň nadvihneme, necháme prebytočné vajce odkvapkať a obalíme ho v strúhanke tak, aby bol rovnomerne pokrytý, ale strúhanku do mäsa pevne nepritláčame (mohla by sa naň prilepiť a obal by sa menej nadvihol).

4. Rezeň hneď opatrne vložíme do horúceho oleja a vyprážame, panvicou jemne krúžime (veľmi opatrne, aby horúci tuk nevyšplechol) a hornú stranu rezňa polievame lyžicou horúcim olejom, kým nie je zospodu zlatohnedý, 1 až 2 minúty. Kliešťami a dierovanou kovovou obracačkou rezeň opatrne obrátime a vyprážame, kým nie je zlatohnedý aj z druhej strany, ešte 1 až 2 minúty. Rezeň opatrne vyberieme z oleja, necháme prebytočný olej odkvapkať a preložíme na pripravené papierové utierky.
5. Obaľovanie a vyprážanie zopakujeme so zvyšnými rezňami a dávame pozor, aby sa teplota oleja udržala.
6. Rezne preložíme na taniere a podávame s mesiačikmi citróna a podľa chuti s rakúskym zemiakovým šalátom.

en.v: instead of frying as in the method below, the dish can be made in the air fryer.

c.t: Oil: 1–2 tbsp oil, sprayed or brushed on (instead of the frying oil)
Air fryer: 200 °C, 6–8 min, turning halfway (preheat 3 min; don't crowd the basket — cook in batches)
Steps:
1. Pound and bread the cutlets as in steps 1–3 (skip filling and heating the fat in step 3), then spray both sides generously with oil.
2. Air-fry one cutlet at a time until golden and crisp, 6–8 minutes, turning it halfway. The crust stays flat; it does not puff away from the meat as when fried.
3. Serve with lemon wedges and potato salad as in step 6.

en.t: 1. Trim brisket of hard and excess fat, leaving 0.5 cm layer of fat along top. Coat brisket liberally in your favorite dry rub and wrap in heavy duty aluminum foil. Place in refrigerator and let it sit for at least 8 hours and up to 1 day.
2. Fire up your smoker to between 100 and 110 °C. Add chunks of wood, and when they begin to smoke, remove brisket from foil and place in smoker.

3. Cook brisket at 100 to 110 °C until an instant read thermometer reads 74 °C in flat section of brisket, 10 to 12 hours. Wrap brisket in heavy duty aluminum foil and put back into smoker. Continue cooking until point section of brisket registers 90 °C, 4 to 6 hours more. Remove from smoker, let rest at least 30 minutes, slice and serve.

sk.t: 1. Z hrudí odrežeme tvrdý a prebytočný tuk a na vrchu necháme vrstvu tuku hrubú 0,5 cm. Hrudí štedro obalíme v obľúbenej suchej marináde a zabalíme do pevného alobalu. Vložíme do chladničky a necháme aspoň 8 hodín a najviac 1 deň.
2. Udiareň rozohrejeme na 100 až 110 °C. Pridáme kúsky dreva, a keď začnú dymiť, hrudí vybalíme z alobalu a vložíme do udiarne.

3. Hrudí údime pri 100 až 110 °C, kým vpichový teplomer neukáže v plochej časti 74 °C, 10 až 12 hodín. Hrudí zabalíme do pevného alobalu a vrátime do udiarne. Údime ďalej, kým hrubšia časť (point) neukáže 90 °C, ešte 4 až 6 hodín. Vyberieme z udiarne, necháme aspoň 30 minút odpočívať, nakrájame a podávame.

c.t: For best results, season and trim the meat and rest it uncovered in the refrigerator at least overnight. A centre-cut tenderloin is the chateaubriand; ask your butcher, or trim a whole tenderloin and keep the ends for another use. Plan on 225 g of meat per person.

Najlepšie je mäso ochutiť, očistiť a nechať ho odokryté v chladničke aspoň cez noc. Stredová časť sviečkovice je samotný chateaubriand; požiadajte mäsiara alebo očistite celú sviečkovicu a konce použite inak. Počítajte 225 g mäsa na osobu.

en.t: 1 center-cut trimmed beef tenderloin (900 g–1400 g)
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
4 tbsp (57 g) unsalted butter
4 sprigs thyme
1 shallot, roughly sliced
Finely minced chives, for serving
Coarse sea salt, such as fleur de sel or Maldon, for serving
120 ml heavy cream, for the horseradish sauce
120 ml crème fraîche or sour cream, for the horseradish sauce
120 ml store-bought or homemade preserved horseradish, for the horseradish sauce
2 tbsp (6 g) minced chives, for the horseradish sauce
1 tbsp (15 ml) freshly squeezed lemon juice, for the horseradish sauce
kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste, for the horseradish sauce

1. Make the horseradish sauce: In a medium bowl, whisk the cream until thickened but not yet at soft peaks. Fold in the crème fraîche, horseradish, chives, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Refrigerate for 30 to 60 minutes before using (or up to 2 weeks in an airtight container).

2. The Day Before: Using butcher's twine, tie tenderloin at 2.5 cm intervals using butcher's knots. Season generously with salt and pepper. Transfer to a wire rack set in a foil-lined rimmed baking sheet and refrigerate uncovered at least overnight and up to 2 nights.

3. When Ready to Cook: Adjust oven rack to center position and preheat oven to 107 °C (fan 87 °C). Place baking sheet with rack and tenderloin in oven and roast until internal temperature registers 50 °C (49 to 52 °C) on an instant-read thermometer, 2 to 3 hours. Remove from oven and set aside at room temperature for 10 minutes. Cut and remove twine.

4. To Finish Under the Broiler: Adjust rack to 15 cm from broiler element and preheat broiler to high. Heat butter, swirling, in a medium skillet over high heat until foaming subsides and butter turns a light nutty brown. Add thyme and shallots and stir until crackling stops. Pour butter mixture over tenderloin and spread with a spoon until all surfaces are coated. Remove shallots from top surface of meat. Place pan with tenderloin under broiler and broil, turning every 30 seconds, until meat is well browned on all sides and internal temperature registers 52 °C for rare or 54 °C for medium-rare, about 2 minutes total. Proceed to step 5.

5. To Finish on the Stovetop: Heat butter, swirling, in a medium skillet over high heat until foaming subsides and butter turns a light nutty brown. Add tenderloin, shallots, and thyme and cook, turning occasionally and spooning hot butter and aromatics over roast, until meat is well browned on all sides and internal temperature registers 52 °C for rare or 54 °C for medium-rare, about 1 1/2 minutes.
6. Transfer tenderloin to a cutting board and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Slice into 1.5 cm slices, sprinkle with chives and coarse sea salt, and serve with Horseradish Cream Sauce.

1. Chrenová omáčka: v strednej mise metličkou šľaháme smotanu, kým nezhustne, ale ešte netvorí mäkké špičky. Vmiešame kyslú smotanu, chren, pažítku, citrónovú šťavu, soľ a korenie. Pred použitím necháme 30 až 60 minút v chladničke (vo vzduchotesnej nádobe vydrží až 2 týždne).

2. Deň vopred: sviečkovicu previažeme mäsiarskym špagátom v rozostupoch 2,5 cm mäsiarskymi uzlami. Výdatne osolíme a okoreníme. Preložíme na mriežku vloženú do plechu s okrajom vysteleného alobalom a necháme odkrytú v chladničke aspoň cez noc a najviac 2 noci.

3. Keď sme pripravení piecť: rošt v rúre posunieme do strednej polohy a rúru rozohrejeme na 107 °C (teplovzdušnú na 87 °C). Plech s mriežkou a sviečkovicou vložíme do rúry a pečieme, kým vpichový teplomer neukáže vnútornú teplotu 50 °C (49 až 52 °C), 2 až 3 hodiny. Vyberieme z rúry a necháme 10 minút postáť pri izbovej teplote. Prestrihneme a odstránime špagát.

4. Dokončenie pod grilom v rúre: rošt posunieme 15 cm od grilovacieho telesa a gril rozohrejeme na najvyšší stupeň. V strednej panvici zohrievame na silnom ohni maslo a krúžime ním, kým neprestane peniť a nezíska svetlo orieškovú hnedú farbu. Pridáme tymián a šalotku a miešame, kým neprestane praskať. Maslovou zmesou polejeme sviečkovicu a lyžicou ju rozotrieme, kým nie sú pokryté všetky strany. Z vrchnej strany mäsa odstránime šalotku. Plech so sviečkovicou vložíme pod gril a grilujeme, každých 30 sekúnd obrátime, kým mäso nie je zo všetkých strán dobre opečené a vnútorná teplota nedosiahne 52 °C pre krvavé (rare) alebo 54 °C pre medium-rare, spolu asi 2 minúty. Pokračujeme krokom 5.

5. Dokončenie na sporáku: v strednej panvici zohrievame na silnom ohni maslo a krúžime ním, kým neprestane peniť a nezíska svetlo orieškovú hnedú farbu. Pridáme sviečkovicu, šalotku a tymián a opekáme, občas obrátime a mäso polievame lyžicou horúcim maslom s aromatickými prísadami, kým nie je zo všetkých strán dobre opečené a vnútorná teplota nedosiahne 52 °C pre krvavé (rare) alebo 54 °C pre medium-rare, asi 1 1/2 minúty.
6. Sviečkovicu preložíme na dosku na krájanie a necháme 5 minút odpočívať. Nakrájame na plátky hrubé 1,5 cm, posypeme pažítkou a hrubou morskou soľou a podávame s chrenovou smotanovou omáčkou.

cat.en: For best results, season and trim the meat and rest it uncovered in the refrigerator at least overnight. A centre-cut tenderloin is the chateaubriand; ask your butcher, or trim a whole tenderloin and keep the ends for another use.

c.t: Pekin ducks (also sold as Long Island ducks) are usually frozen and must thaw in the refrigerator for at least 1 day before cooking. To feed 6, steam one duck after the other, then roast all the pieces together in an oversized roasting pan or a large rimmed baking sheet.

Kačice plemena pekinská (predávajú sa aj ako Long Island) sú zvyčajne mrazené a pred varením sa musia rozmrazovať v chladničke aspoň 1 deň. Pre 6 osôb naparte kačice jednu po druhej a potom všetky kusy pečte spolu vo veľkom pekáči alebo na veľkom plechu s okrajom.

en.t: 235 ml fresh squeezed orange juice (from 2-3 large oranges)
2 tbsp (30 ml) fresh lime juice (from 1 lime)
2 tbsp (30 ml) honey
1 whole Pekin duck (about 2040 g), neck and giblets discarded
Salt and ground black pepper
1. **FOR THE GLAZE:**
2. Bring all ingredients to boil in small saucepan. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until slightly thickened and reduced to scant 59 ml, 25 to 30 minutes. Set glaze aside until ready to use.
3. **FOR THE DUCK:**

4. Meanwhile, set V-rack in large, high-sided roasting pan and position duck, breast side up, on rack. Add water to just below bottom of duck. Bring water to boil over high heat, cover pan tightly with aluminum foil (or pan cover, if available), adjust heat to medium (to maintain a slow, steady boil), and steam, adding more hot water to maintain water level if necessary, until skin has pulled away from at least one leg. For duck with very moist, tender meat and slightly crisp skin once roasted, steam about 40 minutes. Steam 10 minutes longer for somewhat denser meat and very crisp skin after roasting. Transfer duck to carving board and, when cool enough to handle, cut into six pieces: 2 breast pieces, 2 leg/thigh pieces, and 2 wings. (Cooled duck, either whole or cut into pieces, can be wrapped in foil and refrigerated overnight.)

5. Adjust oven rack to bottom position and heat oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C). Season pieces on both sides with salt and pepper to taste and position skin side down in lightly oiled roasting pan. Roast, carefully pouring off fat if more than two tbsp accumulate in pan, until skin on breast pieces is rich brown color and crisp, about 25 minutes. Transfer breast pieces to platter and cover with foil to keep warm. Again, pour off excess fat from pan, turn leg/thigh and wing pieces skin side up, and continue roasting until skin on these pieces is deep brown and crisp, 15 to 20 minutes longer. Again, pour off excess fat from pan. Return breast pieces to pan and brush both sides of every piece with glaze. Roast until glaze is hot and richly colored on duck pieces, 3 to 4 minutes. Serve immediately.

1. **NA GLAZÚRU:**

2. Všetky suroviny privedieme v malom kastróliku do varu. Oheň stlmíme na stredne mierny a varíme, kým mierne nezhustne a nezredukuje sa na necelých 59 ml, 25 až 30 minút. Glazúru odložíme až do použitia.

Pre kačicu s veľmi šťavnatým, mäkkým mäsom a po upečení mierne chrumkavou kožou naparujeme asi 40 minút. Pre o niečo pevnejšie mäso a po upečení veľmi chrumkavú kožu naparujeme o 10 minút dlhšie.
